mapper.sql: id, order_id, biz_stage, biz_ref_id, file_name, object_key, storage_provider, file_hash, file_type, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_name, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into wo_attachment (order_id, biz_stage, biz_ref_id, file_name, object_key, storage_provider, file_hash, file_type, file_size, uploader_id, uploader_name, create_time, del_flag) values (#{orderId}, #{bizStage}, #{bizRefId}, #{fileName}, #{objectKey}, #{storageProvider}, #{fileHash}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName}, #{createTime}, '0')
mapper.select: select from wo_attachment where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
select from wo_attachment where order_id = #{orderId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time, id
mapper.update: update wo_attachment set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id} and uploader_id = #{uploaderId} and order_id is null and del_flag = '0'
